title: Music service chips: accessible name matches the visible text (axe label-content-name-mismatch)
acceptance: Each Music › service chip (for example "SoundCloud, Connected") has an accessible name that contains its visible text in the same order, so axe label-content-name-mismatch (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name) no longer fires on Music.
The 'Music songs' entry is removed from KNOWN_AXE in e2e/smoke.spec.ts and the smoke stays green at 1440 and 390 wide.
nextAction: Found by #686 (RF-151), whose e2e smoke is the first to visit Music: axe flags the three service chips in apps/web/src/components/Dashboard.tsx (aria-label "<Service>, <state>"), and #686 lists it in KNOWN_AXE for 'Music songs'. Likely fix: drop the aria-label and let the visible service name and state mark form the name. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Local e2e smoke on the RF-151 branch: label-content-name-mismatch (serious) on button[aria-label="SoundCloud, Connected"], "Spotify, Catalog only" and "Apple Music, Catalog only". Recorded as known for 'Music songs'.
